name: Tunde
bio: Lapo Baby from Nyanya. Sold sachet water before he could spell 'sachet'. Grinds beside you, always.

name: Slim
bio: Always has new sneakers and no visible job. Calls everybody 'my guy'. Knows people who know people.

name: Mrs. Okafor
bio: Economics lecturer and consultant. Does not do shortcuts. Will open doors if you show up on time.

name: Bolaji Danjuma-Adeyemi
bio: Son of (fictional) Senator Danjuma-Adeyemi. Convoy to school. Not a bad person, just never had to check a price.

name: Amaka
bio: Sharp, funny, and allergic to fake people. Met you when you were both still figuring life out.

name: Mr. Felix (QuickKash)
bio: QuickKash Microfinance. Smiles when you borrow. Your whole contact list hears from him when you don't pay.

name: Prophet Profit
bio: Rented Lamborghini, borrowed watch, 'proven signals'. Sells courses about getting rich by selling courses.

name: Uncle Sylvester
bio: Appears only when there is money, a burial, or land. Has never once brought a gift.

name: Senator Danjuma-Adeyemi
bio: (Fictional) Senator, landlord of half of Maitama, builder of Guzape Hills. Never raises his voice. Never has to.

name: Halima Bello
bio: Investigative reporter with three phones and no fear. Has been threatened by better-connected people than you.

name: Baba Yakubu
bio: His family farmed in Guzape long before Abuja was a capital. Now he sleeps in a church hall and waits.

name: Ifeoma
bio: Sat two rows in front of you in primary school. Neatest handwriting in class. Laughed at your jokes, mostly.

name: Zainab
bio: Your first real crush in secondary school. Strict parents, quick laugh, terrible at keeping secrets.
